incidents.summary: Smith & Nephew agreed to pay $22.2 million to settle FCPA offenses involving its subsidiaries and admitted bribing government-employed doctors in Greece over the preceding decade.

sources.title: Smith & Nephew
sources.quote: In February 2012, Smith & Nephew plc agreed to pay US$22.2 million to settle multiple US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA) offenses committed by its US and German subsidiaries.

sources.title: Smith & Nephew
sources.quote: The company admitted to having bribed government-employed doctors in Greece to use its medical equipment over the past decade.

sources.title: Medical device maker discloses investigation by the SEC and Indian authorities | Willkie Compliance Concourse
sources.quote: Under the terms of the DPA, the Company agreed to pay a criminal penalty of $16.8 million, make significant improvements to its compliance program, and hire a compliance monitor for 18 months.

incidents.summary: Smith & Nephew entered a settlement alongside three other device manufacturers, agreeing to industry reforms and corporate monitoring to avoid criminal conspiracy charges.

sources.title: Smith & Nephew
sources.quote: In September 2007, Biomet Inc., DePuy Orthopaedics Inc. (part of Johnson & Johnson), Smith & Nephew PLC and Zimmer Holdings Inc. entered into settlement agreements, under which they agreed to pay $300 million in total, adopt industry overhauls and undertake corporate monitoring to avoid criminal charges of conspiracy.

incidents.summary: Smith & Nephew agreed in 2026 to pay $350,000 to settle a worker class action challenging retirement-plan managed account fees and its handling of forfeited employee funds.

sources.title: Smith & Nephew Settles 401(k) Fee, Forfeiture Suit for $350,000
sources.quote: agreed to pay $350,000 to settle a proposed class action challenging its 401(k) plan’s managed account fees and how it handles the money forfeited by departing employees.

sources.title: Smith & Nephew Settles 401(k) Fee, Forfeiture Suit for $350,000
sources.quote: It also requires the company to look for a new managed account provider by the end of 2027, according to a Feb. 13 motion seeking preliminary settlement approval

incidents.summary: Smith & Nephew Medical was convicted and fined £230,000 plus £111,000 in costs after an inadequately planned unloading operation caused a falling crate to inflict life-changing injuries on a delivery worker.

sources.title: Falling crate seriously injures worker | Health & Safety Matters
sources.quote: Smith & Nephew Medical Ltd was sentenced on 14 September 2026 after Mr Dubey, an employee of Nippon Express (UK) Ltd, was seriously injured when a crate weighing approximately 1.2 tonnes fell from a forklift truck.

sources.title: Falling crate seriously injures worker | Health & Safety Matters
sources.quote: As a result, Mr Dubey was positioned unsafely and the load was lifted in an unsafe manner, causing the crate to fall from the forklift truck and land on him, resulting in life-changing injuries.

sources.title: Falling crate seriously injures worker | Health & Safety Matters
sources.quote: Smith & Nephew Medical Ltd, of Hull, was found guilty of breaching Section 3(1) of the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974. The company was fined £230,000 and ordered to pay £111,000 in costs.

positives: Smith & Nephew issued staff proximity-alert devices to support distancing and prevent coronavirus transmission.

incidents.summary: Smith & Nephew initiated a recall of two K-Wire batches after a complaint identified wires whose size differed from the package label, with the FDA identifying packaging change control as the cause.

sources.title: Class 2 Device Recall  KWIRE
sources.quote: Smith & Nephew, Inc., has initiated a field action to voluntarily remove two batches of K-Wires due to a packaging error.

sources.title: Class 2 Device Recall  KWIRE
sources.quote: A complaint was received indicating that a package contained K-WIRE .062X9 2PT DM wires instead of K-WIRE .045X9 2PT DM as described on the product label.

sources.title: Class 2 Device Recall  KWIRE
sources.quote: FDA Determined Cause 2 | Packaging change control

positives: The Penang manufacturing facility attained LEED Silver certification in 2023.
The Penang facility achieved zero waste-to-landfill, the first facility in the group to do so.
